gem_system.description: Gem drops from monster kills. Every value here is tunable; see docs/draft/gem-system.md for how they combine.

diamond.description: The most precious of gems, crystal clear and brilliant

sapphire.description: Deep blue gemstone prized by nobility

emerald.description: Vibrant green gem associated with nature magic

ruby.description: Blood-red stone that gleams like fire

topaz.description: Golden gemstone that catches light beautifully

garnet.description: Dark red stone often used in jewelry

alexandrite.description: Color-changing gem that shifts in different light

pearl.description: Lustrous sphere formed in oysters and mussels

amber.description: Fossilized tree resin, sometimes containing ancient insects

amethyst.description: Purple quartz crystal with mystical properties

moonstone.description: Pale gem that shimmers like moonlight

citrine.description: Yellow quartz that sparkles like sunlight

bloodstone.description: Dark green stone flecked with red spots

turquoise.description: Blue-green stone often carved into trinkets

quartz.description: Clear crystal common in many regions

azurite.description: Bright blue mineral used in paint and decoration

malachite.description: Bright green stone with swirling patterns

cr_scaling.description: Each curve is a list of [CR, value] points, interpolated log-linearly between points and held flat past the ends. gem_chance is the per-kill chance of a gem (a monster's own gem_chance overrides it). type_tilt and size_tilt reweight the type and size rolls: weight = drop_rate x tilt ^ log10(base_value / 1000) for types, and drop_rate x tilt ^ log10(multiplier) for sizes. A tilt of 1 leaves the base drop_rates unchanged; below 1 favours cheap/small gems, above 1 favours valuable/large ones.

usage.currency: Gems can be sold to merchants for their GP value
usage.trading: High-value gems may be required for special purchases
usage.crafting: Future system may allow gem enhancement of equipment
usage.collection: Rare gems could unlock special content or achievements
